posts.title: 4 myths about iron pans
posts.caption:
Purani baatein, naya iron.

Myth: iron is hard to lift. Tawaana is super lightweight iron.
Myth: iron needs seasoning. No seasoning needed.
Myth: iron always rusts. Tawaana won't rust.
Myth: non-stick needs lots of oil. A few drops is enough.

Swipe through, then tell us which one you believed. tawaana.com

posts.title: 5 rules for a long life
posts.caption:
Save this one for later.

1. Preheat 1 to 2 minutes on low-to-medium flame.
2. Wooden or silicone spatula only.
3. Let it cool, then wash with a soft sponge.
4. A few drops of oil, no aerosol spray.
5. Dry fully and hang it by the loop.

Simple habits keep your Tawaana cooking for years. tawaana.com
